'''Greyble Service''' was a business located on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]].<ref name="Andor 8">{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}}</ref> It was located at [[North Stairs Lane]],<ref name="Andor 1" /> across the street from a [[Unidentified droid parts store|store selling droid parts]]. A [[Color|red]] and yellow [[Aurebesh]] sign stating the business' name, was hanging over the entrance.<ref name="Andor 8" /> Another sign said "PARTS SOLD HERE" in [[Bazeese script]].<ref name="Andor 1" />
